intro: Small crew, big mornings. You'll know everyone by name before the week is out.

members.name: Joe Harlan
members.bio: Former trail crew lead. Started roasting because camp coffee was an insult. Still refuses to stock flavored syrups.

members.name: Mara Chen
members.bio: Baker by trade, early riser by necessity. Writes the soup board in chalk nobody can read but everyone understands.

members.name: Elliot Voss
members.bio: Dialing in espresso since 2019. Will tell you exactly why your home grinder matters, then stop if you look tired.

members.name: Sam Ortiz
members.bio: College nearby, patience abundant. Knows every regular's order and never makes it weird.
